arnold-press.criteria: Standing Arnold press: palms initially facing body, rotate outward while pressing overhead; stable trunk and controlled return. Newly rendered replacement for existing skinned-pilot clip, not a previously absent exercise.

overhead-triceps-extension.criteria: Standing two-dumbbell variant: neutral grips, upper arms fixed beside head; elbow flexion lowers both weights behind head and extension returns overhead.

cable-lateral-raise.criteria: Single left-arm lateral raise with low pulley on opposite side. Stable trunk, slight elbow bend, shoulder-height lift and controlled return. One side demonstrated; repeat on other side.

limits: Procedural illustration with simplified anatomy, hands, clothes and equipment. Top pause is illustrative; no full mesh collision or biomechanics certification. Arnold press replaces an existing separately registered pilot video. Physical Android and production pending.
